abstract: The case histories of two patients with an extragonadal germ-cell tumour are discussed. One had a retroperitoneal embryonal carcinoma, and the other had a mediastinal choriocarcinoma-seminoma. The pathogenesis, symptomatology, diagnosis and treatment of these rare tumours are discussed in some detail.?
abstract_ja: 2例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例歴について検討した。1例は後腹膜の胎児性癌、もう1例は縦隔の絨毛癌・セミノーマであった。これらの稀な腫瘍の病因、症候、診断および治療について、やや詳しく論じる。?
